## Description
The Fish Farm is made of stronger structural and cladding material such as coextruded laminate of polyamide and polyolefin interwoven around an aluminum frame to give rise to a scaffolded retention bladder. It is furnished with a ASTROBIOLOGY research lab with instruments.
